f2_target_modules: F2-WP-605 Child telemetry implementation surface to be resolved by Trigger4 after exact re-entry
problem_or_gap: Current F2 Evidence Spine has a PERFORMANCE channel and causal/tool/effect identity fields, but F2-WP-605 remains unimplemented at the observed aggregate state and there is no admitted tool/effect-bound resource observation payload contract with explicit measurement coverage/semantics and fail-closed termination-cause classification.

proposed_delta.summary: Implement the thinnest F2-native read-only ToolResourceObservation/ResourceEnvelope as PERFORMANCE telemetry using the existing evidence spine rather than importing AgentCgroup's controller or creating a second authority.
proposed_delta.identity_binding: Reuse event_id/run_id/tool_use_id/effect_id/causal_id/generation/provenance_refs from the current Evidence Spine. Do not mint a new causal identity namespace.
proposed_delta.authority_rule: Resource hints are CANDIDATE input only. Any budget/enforcement decision remains deterministic authority-owned and separately receipted. Resource telemetry never becomes effect authority.
proposed_delta.serialization_rule: Use typed canonical serialization compatible with current F2 evidence/run-package mechanisms; no shell-built canonical JSON.
proposed_delta.coverage_rule: MEASURED/DEGRADED/UNKNOWN coverage must be explicit; missing instrumentation must not silently disappear.

counterhypotheses: Existing F2 telemetry and whole-process metrics already localize resource anomalies sufficiently; a new per-tool payload contract is redundant.
Per-tool resource observation overhead exceeds its diagnostic/coordination value for short-lived tools.
Standard portable process/cgroup-v2 observation is sufficient; eBPF enforcement is unnecessary for F2's target deployment.
Tool-call resource distributions measured in SWE-rebench do not transfer to F2 workloads.
upstream_claims_reproduced: Exit code 137 alone can be generated by a deliberate non-OOM SIGKILL and therefore is insufficient OOM evidence.
The production shell JSONL interpolation pattern fails valid-JSON parsing for control-sensitive/unescaped input.
The no-root wrapper's parent-before/after RSS formula can miss a short-lived high-memory child by a very large factor.
Tool-call resource granularity can preserve causal distinctions that collide under run-level aggregates in the F2-native synthetic E4 fixture.
upstream_claims_not_reproduced: AgentCgroup's reported 144-task resource distributions on an F2 workload
reported wrapper overhead under F2 workload
multi-tenant isolation improvement on F2 deployment
any need for sched_ext or memcg_bpf_ops in F2
general predictive value of agent-provided resource hints
F2 target-runtime collector accuracy or coverage
baseline_definition: Current F2 telemetry Evidence Spine at the architecture snapshot: PERFORMANCE is available and causal/tool/effect identity fields exist, but F2-WP-605 aggregate state is NOT_STARTED and no admitted tool-resource payload/collector has runtime credit.
required_tests: schema-valid PERFORMANCE event with exact run/tool/effect/causal/generation binding
deterministic typed serialization for quotes/backslashes/newlines/control characters
coverage-state test: instrumentation failure => DEGRADED/UNKNOWN, never silent absence
exit-137 test: deliberate non-OOM SIGKILL must not classify OOM as observed
resource-hint authority test: hint cannot directly raise or self-grant canonical budget/capability
metric-semantics test: parent endpoint RSS cannot be labeled child peak
replay/determinism test for identical observation input
required_ablations: run-aggregate-only versus tool/effect-bound resource events on the preserved E4 collision fixture
resource payload disabled versus enabled on an F2 child-agent workload
portable observer baseline versus any later privileged cgroup/eBPF observer if such a later experiment is authorized
required_measurements: collector coverage ratio by tool/effect class
measurement accuracy against known child memory/CPU workload
resource anomaly localization gain over aggregate telemetry
expected_token_delta: NO_MODEL_TOKEN_PATH_REQUIRED_BY_DESIGN; MEASURE_IF_ANY MODEL-FACING SUMMARY IS LATER ADDED
expected_latency_delta: UNKNOWN_UNTIL_TRIGGER4_MEASUREMENT; SHOULD BE BOUNDED AND LOWER THAN PRIVILEGED_CONTROLLER_ADOPTION
expected_resource_delta: UNKNOWN_UNTIL_TRIGGER4_MEASUREMENT; MEASUREMENT-ONLY DESIGN EXPECTED TO BE LOWER COMPLEXITY THAN FULL AGENTCGROUP
quality_success_metric: The implementation must preserve at least one causal localization distinction lost by aggregate telemetry, correctly fail closed on unsupported OOM/peak claims, and produce exact identity-bound resource observations with measured bounded overhead on an admitted repository/runtime scope.
rollback_or_reject_rule: Reject or reduce to existing telemetry if per-tool events add no unique anomaly-localization value, collector accuracy/coverage is insufficient, overhead is materially negative relative to diagnostic gain, or implementation requires a second canonical authority. Do not escalate to AgentCgroup/eBPF enforcement solely because measurement-first candidate underperforms.
known_failure_modes: agent resource hint becomes self-grant authority
PID+timestamp substituted for immutable causal identity
wrapper RSS mislabeled as child peak
backend presence mistaken for verified attach capability
requested policy mistaken for applied policy
GPL-2.0 code copied when mechanism distillation/reimplementation was intended
upstream SWE-rebench findings silently promoted to F2 runtime facts
trigger4_reentry_instruction: Refresh F2 main and affected telemetry/WP605 surfaces before claiming work. If WP605 or equivalent resource-observation scope is already actively claimed/implemented, route around duplication and use this packet only as falsification/acceptance evidence.
